_: The ~44 s Reel / YouTube Short of the double infinitive (dubbele infinitief, B1; site topic topic.dubbele-infinitief-b1, /en/grammar/dubbele-infinitief-b1/). Aimed at people who already speak Dutch fairly well: the hook is the classic slip 'ik heb gemoeten wachten'. The opening (title + the wrong sentence) is complete on frame 0 and Emma's English intro starts at ~0.4 s (subtitled, the only recorded voice); then the rule, four verb groups, a verb stack for fun, one quiz question and the call to action. Read by DubbeleInfinitiefReel.jsx and by demo/dubbele-infinitief/build_track.py, which times the scenes on Emma's recording. Sentence markup: [x] = the conjugated verb, usually hebben/zijn (orange), {x} = an infinitive (green), ~x~ = a wrong form (struck through). In EN text, Dutch words are *italic*.
